name: Vodacom Lesotho Maseru West Data Center
notes: Vodacom Lesotho official page (A): fixed business services hosted in its two Data Centres at Maseru West and Lekokoaneng; official page also markets colocation. Capacity/power not disclosed; datacentermap places it at Kokobela Village Road 100, Maseru (C corroboration).

name: LCA Data Centre / LIXP host facility
notes: LIXP official page (A): Lesotho Internet Exchange Point C/O Lesotho Communications Authority, 30 Princess Margaret Road, Old Europa, Maseru; peers incl. ETL, Vodacom, MCST, NUL, LECC, Comnet, LsNIC; hosts Google global caches, Akamai caches and L-Root server. Institutional/interconnection facility; IXP is not an independent public colo datacenter.

name: Econet Telecom Lesotho (ETL) data centre lead
notes: ETL is a licensed incumbent and LIXP peer with Maseru operations, but no named datacenter facility was found in official/operator pages or press as of 2026-08-12. Weak lead; needs ETL/LCA/land/power evidence to upgrade.
District negative scan (2026-08-12, incl. Butha-Buthe spelling): no datacenter project or facility specific to Botha-Bothe district; industrial estate/comm-sites only.
District negative scan (2026-08-12): no datacenter project or facility specific to Leribe (Hlotse, Maputsoe); industrial estate items only.

name: Vodacom Lesotho Lekokoaneng Data Center
notes: Vodacom Lesotho official page names the second Data Centre at Lekokoaneng (hosting fixed services). Lekokoaneng lies on the Maseru-TY/Berea side and is a Berea-district locality per LENA/mapcarta, though datacentermap files it under the Maseru market. Distinct facility, not merged with Maseru West. Capacity not disclosed.
District negative scan (2026-08-12): no datacenter project or facility specific to Mafeteng district.

name: Mohale's Hoek Government Data Centre (National Data Centre)
developer: Government of Lesotho / Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology (e-Gov project)
notes: gov.ls articles confirm the Mohale's Hoek data centre built under the Lesotho e-Government Infrastructure Project Phase I (National Data Centre, per communications.gov.ls); power house construction and furniture/equipment adverts indicate commissioning/integration stage. 2021 EOI covers operationalisation of Mohale's Hoek DC and integration of the three government data centres (two others' locations undisclosed). Capacity not disclosed.
District negative scan (2026-08-12): no datacenter project or facility specific to Quthing district.
District negative scan (2026-08-12): no datacenter project or facility specific to Qacha's Nek district.

name: Kobong Hydropower and AI Data Centre Project
developer: Convalt Energy / Oxbow Energy Solutions with Government of Lesotho (Ministry of Energy)
notes: gov.ls (A) confirms approval of the Kobong Project: M100 billion (US$6.2bn) hydropower + AI data centre development backed by Convalt Energy, largest foreign investment in Lesotho's history; MoA signed 2026-06-04. 1,200MW is hydropower generation capacity, NOT IT load (do not convert); no feasibility/EIA/LEWA licence/land evidence yet - announced/approved pipeline only.
District negative scan (2026-08-12): no datacenter project or facility specific to Thaba-Tseka district.
